entities.summary: Kimberly Noel Kardashian is an American actress, television and media personality, socialite, model, producer, fashion designer and businesswoman. She first gained media attention in 2007 following the unauthorized release of a sex tape with American singer Ray J. Afterwards, she and her family began to appear on the E! reality television series Keeping Up with the Kardashians. The show aired until 2021, and its success led to the formation of several spin-offs before its revival in the form of, Hulu's The Kardashians (2022–present) as part of her and her family's multi-year deal with the streamer.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a prominent reality TV personality and influencer, Kim Kardashian has had a significant impact on popular culture in North America, with her family's show Keeping Up with the Kardashians airing for over a decade and spawning multiple spin-offs. Her influence extends to fashion, beauty, and entrepreneurship, making her one of the most recognizable celebrities of her generation.
